research_problem: Can gaze patterns during emotional reading distinguish self-reported depression and suicidal ideation?
ai_method: Deep learning combines within-trial and between-trial eye-movement variation.
study_summary: In 126 young adults, discrimination is stronger against healthy controls than between depression and suicidality; the latter AUC is only 0.609.
limitations: Labels reflect screening questionnaires rather than independently established clinical diagnoses; these results do not validate suicide-risk prediction.

research_problem: Can changing physiological patterns predict which ICU sepsis patients will deteriorate?
ai_method: Latent trajectory discovery feeds an ensemble using dynamic physiological variability.
study_summary: Across 47,936 patients, three recovery trajectories emerge; external AUROC falls from 0.84 in MIMIC-III to 0.77 in eICU. Implementation is associated with better reported care outcomes.
limitations: Retrospective prediction and implementation associations do not alone establish that the model caused mortality reductions.

research_problem: Can automated DXA spine measurements reveal genetic associations missed by diagnosis codes?
ai_method: Deep vertebral segmentation and landmark detection generate a quantitative curvature phenotype for GWAS.
study_summary: Analysis of 57,588 UK Biobank participants identifies two novel scoliosis loci; proxy curvature correlates 0.83 with Cobb angles in 150 people.
limitations: The measurement is a scoliosis proxy; the discovery population is European and loci require functional follow-up.

research_problem: Do chatbot interventions improve depression and anxiety symptoms?
ai_method: Random-effects synthesis of randomized chatbot trials evaluates symptom effects and severity subgroups.
study_summary: Thirty-nine eligible studies show modest pooled effects: Hedges’ g is 0.31 for depression and 0.28 for anxiety. Greater depressive severity is associated with larger effects.
limitations: Depression and anxiety analyses use overlapping study sets; their participant totals must not be added or treated as one newly conducted trial.

research_problem: Can psychiatric dialogue systems combine structured diagnosis with empathetic communication?
ai_method: WiseMind coordinates reasoning and emotional-support LLM agents through a DSM-5 knowledge graph.
study_summary: Across 1,206 simulated conversations and 180 real-user sessions, reported top-1 diagnostic accuracy is 85.6%, with psychiatrist review supporting response quality.
limitations: Simulation and user-session accuracy do not establish safe autonomous psychiatric diagnosis or improved patient outcomes.

research_problem: Can DeepSeek produce useful radiology-residency examination questions?
ai_method: LLM-generated and expert-written multiple-choice questions are blinded and mixed for resident evaluation.
study_summary: Forty residents answer fourteen questions from each source. Overall correctness is similar, but generated clinical-scenario and higher-order items have weaknesses.
limitations: This is a small educational question experiment, not an assessment of clinical diagnostic performance or patient care.

research_problem: Can text-conditioned synthetic ophthalmic images improve rare-disease classifiers?
ai_method: EyeDiff generates lesion-preserving images to augment minority classes for several foundation-model families.
study_summary: Expert evaluation supports image fidelity, and augmentation across eleven datasets improves diagnosis benchmarks for common and rare retinal diseases.
limitations: Benchmark gains from synthetic augmentation do not establish performance under prospective clinical acquisition or exclude synthetic-data artifacts.

research_problem: Can uncertainty-aware pathology AI reduce missed lymph-node metastases while limiting review workload?
ai_method: UPATHLN combines a pathology foundation encoder with a separate uncertainty estimator that routes uncertain negatives to pathologists.
study_summary: Development uses 26,229 nodes from fourteen primary sites. The review-routed workflow reports conditional sensitivity of 100% and reduces negative-node review by 73.2%.
limitations: The perfect sensitivity applies to the conditional AI-plus-review workflow in evaluated cohorts, not an autonomous guarantee across all patients.

research_problem: Can digital twins optimize aminoglycoside exposure while accounting for neonatal physiology and evolving resistance?
ai_method: An LSTM updates renal filtration within coupled physiological pharmacokinetic and evolutionary pharmacodynamic models; optimal and predictive control select dosing.
study_summary: Calibration uses 1,634 neonates. Simulations achieve bacteriostatic exposure, with model-predictive control reducing late bacterial rebound.
limitations: In-silico dosing success and modeled safety are not randomized evidence that the regimen improves neonatal clinical outcomes.

research_problem: Does computerized CTG assistance improve clinicians’ interpretation of intrapartum recordings?
ai_method: A randomized multi-reader experiment compares clinician predictions with and without computerized CTG support.
study_summary: Among 211 clinicians from 23 countries assessing 100 recordings, assistance improves success from 54.0% to 61.4% and sensitivity from 49.3% to 61.7%.
limitations: Clinicians are randomized to interpretation conditions; this is a reader experiment, not a patient-treatment RCT.

research_problem: How should medical-device regulation adapt to generative AI and language models?
ai_method: Regulatory perspective examines GenAI device risks and limitations of existing oversight frameworks.
study_summary: The authors advocate internationally coordinated regulatory-science research incorporating multidisciplinary expertise and diverse populations.
limitations: This is a policy argument with no new model benchmark, clinical cohort or intervention-effect estimate.

research_problem: Can one image-domain neural denoiser generalize across accelerated MRI organs, vendors and protocols?
ai_method: A unified deep denoising model is trained on paired noisy and clean reconstructed MR images.
study_summary: Training uses 148,930 pairs from six centers and four vendors; evaluation includes 20,143 test pairs, 46,870 external images and blinded radiologist assessment.
limitations: Prospective source-image collection, external benchmarking and reader evaluation are separate design elements; image counts do not equal patient counts.

research_problem: Does collaborative workflow order change the diagnostic value of clinician–LLM collaboration?
ai_method: A custom system combines independent human and AI assessments, testing AI-first versus AI-second synthesis.
study_summary: Seventy clinicians are randomized; collaborative accuracy is 85% or 82%, compared with 75% using conventional resources and 90% for AI alone.
limitations: The randomized units are clinicians doing diagnostic assessments, not patients receiving AI-directed treatment.

research_problem: Can smartphone videos support functional assessment and patient communication for childhood ptosis?
ai_method: The platform combines morphological measurement, blink-function analysis and a domain-adapted dialogue model.
study_summary: Evaluation uses 3,164 blink clips and 1,229 images; functional assessment reports AUC 0.993 and real-world stratification accuracy of 0.89.
limitations: Videos, images and people are different denominators; high measurement accuracy does not by itself establish improved surgical or visual outcomes.

research_problem: Do correct and misleading AI explanations affect novice learners symmetrically?
ai_method: A randomized educational experiment compares diagnostic reasoning under AI misinformation, correct explanations and a control.
study_summary: Among 111 students, misleading explanations lower diagnostic accuracy, whereas correct explanations show no significant benefit over the control.
limitations: This measures learner decisions and confidence in a specified task; it is not a patient randomized clinical trial.

research_problem: What enables biomedical AI to deliver precision cardiovascular care beyond model accuracy?
ai_method: A perspective synthesizes multimodal AI applications across EHR, imaging, omics and wearable data.
study_summary: The argument identifies evidence gaps, implementation burdens and fragmented governance as barriers to lasting clinical benefit.
limitations: This overview does not contribute a single new model cohort or quantify a causal cardiovascular-outcome improvement.

research_problem: Can low-dose biplanar radiographs replace CT for rapid patient-specific bone modeling?
ai_method: SSR-KD combines semi-supervised reconstruction with knowledge distillation to generate 3D bone geometry.
study_summary: The reported reconstruction time is thirty seconds with average error below one millimeter; expert osteotomy simulations show applicability comparable to CT-derived annotations.
limitations: Simulation of surgical planning does not establish equivalent intraoperative safety or patient outcomes.

research_problem: Can longitudinal retinal pretraining improve future systemic and ocular disease-risk prediction?
ai_method: RETFound Plus models time and person identity across repeated fundus photographs.
study_summary: Pretraining uses 1,304,292 photographs from 304,345 participants. External multi-region evaluation shows improved calibration and larger risk-prediction gains for systemic than ocular outcomes.
limitations: Photographs from repeated visits are correlated observations; prognostic improvements do not show that screening changes clinical outcomes.

research_problem: Can a two-stage mortality warning system reduce false alarms in emergency care?
ai_method: AI-TEW combines machine-learning mortality prediction, risk-tier thresholds and LLM interpretation of SHAP-derived risk factors.
study_summary: Across 174,292 ED visits, tiering raises positive predictive value to 32.5–40.5%; an LLM filtering layer further improves external alert precision.
limitations: Threshold optimization trades sensitivity and workload against precision; retrospective alert performance does not establish a patient survival benefit.

research_problem: How mature is clinical evidence for agentic AI?
ai_method: A scoping review characterizes autonomous, goal-directed and multi-agent healthcare systems.
study_summary: Seven eligible studies cover emergency care, oncology, radiology and rehabilitation, but only one trial involves patients.
limitations: Exploratory technical success across a few studies cannot establish routine clinical effectiveness or a stable definition of agentic AI.

research_problem: Can hospitals collaboratively learn fetal CHD diagnosis despite differences in ultrasound data?
ai_method: Federated prototypes align clinical-concept and disease-subtype representations across sites without sharing source patient data.
study_summary: Experiments at four tertiary hospitals improve F1, sensitivity and specificity relative to competing federated methods.
limitations: Cross-hospital benchmark improvement does not establish first-trimester clinical-outcome benefit; federation does not itself eliminate all privacy risks.

research_problem: Can fetal cardiac function be quantified automatically from echocardiograms?
ai_method: Deep detection and segmentation feed quality checks, geometric measurements and gestational-age reference scores.
study_summary: Development uses 52,942 annotated images from 1,940 normal echocardiograms; separate normal and abnormal test datasets support reproducibility against experts.
limitations: Images and echocardiograms are different units; normal-dominated development may limit generalization to abnormal anatomy.

research_problem: Can unlabeled cardiac MRI improve anatomical segmentation when expert labels are scarce?
ai_method: A semi-supervised mutual ensemble enforces consistency across both data transformations and network predictions.
study_summary: Comparative experiments show better segmentation than existing methods under matched annotation conditions.
limitations: The reported task is anatomical segmentation; the abstract does not quantify a new patient cohort or demonstrate treatment-outcome improvement.

research_problem: Can generative digital twins explore transportability of randomized-trial treatment effects?
ai_method: RCT-Twin-GAN conditions generated trial populations on covariate distributions from another trial or an EHR population.
study_summary: SPRINT and ACCORD twin populations reproduce contrasting trial patterns while balancing treatment arms and matching target covariates.
limitations: Synthetic treatment-effect transport depends on modeled covariate–outcome relationships; generated twins are not newly randomized patients.

research_problem: Which stromal pathways connect chromosomal instability with colorectal liver metastasis?
ai_method: Single-cell profiles, coexpression networks, matrix factorization and an AI biological knowledge graph prioritize CIN-related signaling.
study_summary: CCDC3 is linked to a CXCR3–STAT3–CDT1 pathway; cell and mouse perturbation experiments suppress metastatic traits when the axis is disrupted.
limitations: The work combines computational prioritization with mechanistic biology; mouse and cell effects do not establish human therapeutic efficacy.

research_problem: What pricing arrangements make diagnostic AI understandable and budgetable for healthcare buyers?
ai_method: Semi-structured stakeholder interviews are analyzed using deductive and inductive thematic coding.
study_summary: Seventeen decision makers favor transparent hybrid fees, clinical billing units and support costs over opaque usage-based charges.
limitations: These qualitative preferences concern AI adoption economics; they are not a model-performance benchmark or a measured procurement-effect estimate.

research_problem: Can dynamic 3D CMR representations improve long-term prognosis after myocardial infarction?
ai_method: ReconSeg3D reconstructs ventricular motion; HeartTTable uses spatiotemporal decomposition and cross-attention to combine images with 45 tabular variables.
study_summary: The reported five-year MACE AUC is 0.934 and C-index is 0.897, exceeding tabular-only comparators.
limitations: Risk discrimination in evaluated patients does not establish that acting on these predictions improves postoperative outcomes.

research_problem: How do AI systems and clinicians compare when analyzing surgical or interventional video?
ai_method: A systematic review and exploratory meta-analysis compare autonomous AI, unassisted clinicians and AI-assisted clinicians.
study_summary: Of 146 included studies, 76 enter quantitative synthesis; assisted clinicians improve sensitivity and specificity over unassisted clinicians.
limitations: Studies directly evaluating assistance are fewer than head-to-head benchmarks; pooled comparisons do not establish universal superiority in live procedures.

research_problem: Can serial MRI AI detect silent new infarctions that indicate future stroke risk?
ai_method: A convolutional network with supervised contrastive learning compares paired FLAIR slices.
study_summary: Development uses 25,451 paired slices from 1,055 patients. An independent 307-person cohort links model-positive silent infarcts to higher subsequent stroke risk.
limitations: The prognostic association is observational; slice counts are not participant counts and detection does not prove prevention benefit.

research_problem: Does volumetric context improve retinal foundation-model diagnosis over single OCT slices?
ai_method: A video transformer, V-JEPA, is fine-tuned on OCT volumes and compared with retinal and natural-image foundation models.
study_summary: Across five datasets, average AUROC is 0.94 versus 0.90 for the strongest image-only comparator.
limitations: The evaluated diagnoses and dataset mix constrain generalization; this comparison does not establish prospective clinical superiority.

research_problem: Can ultrasound AI distinguish follicular thyroid carcinoma from adenoma before surgery?
ai_method: Deep image classification also separates carcinoma invasion subtypes and supports radiologist interpretation.
study_summary: The retrospective multicenter study includes 1,531 development patients and 900 external-test patients; external discrimination AUC ranges from 0.816 to 0.847.
limitations: External retrospective testing and reader assistance are not patient randomization or evidence that AI-guided management reduces unnecessary surgery.

research_problem: Why does validation terminology cause disagreement across medical-AI disciplines?
ai_method: A conceptual analysis compares 94 themes across communication, AI/ML, clinical practice, regulation and business.
study_summary: The authors develop five consensus proposals for qualifying validation terms with their specific purpose and context.
limitations: This is terminology and governance work; the theme counts are analytical categories, not model-validation cohorts.

research_problem: Is primary-care autonomous retinopathy screening associated with downstream specialist attendance?
ai_method: Propensity matching and inverse-probability-weighted regression compare AI-triggered and clinician-triggered referrals.
study_summary: Among 3,745 adults with diabetes, AI-assisted screening is associated with improved specialist presentation for African-American patients.
limitations: The exploratory observational association may reflect residual confounding; it does not prove that AI caused improved eye-care access.

research_problem: Can real-time prescription activity provide earlier influenza surveillance and longer-range forecasts?
ai_method: Convergent cross-mapping assesses dynamical relationships, followed by GNN, Mamba and LSTM spatiotemporal forecasting.
study_summary: Analysis covers 21.08 million transactions across 31 provinces; prescriptions show a two-week lead and support a reported 96-day forecast horizon.
limitations: Dynamical coupling is not randomized causal evidence; prescriptions also respond to environmental conditions and healthcare behavior.

research_problem: Can pretrained EHR sequence models predict antibiotic-related skin reactions?
ai_method: Medical codes are modeled through language-style pretraining and fine-tuning, with nursing-text-derived rash outcomes.
study_summary: A three-hospital Korean dataset includes 802,131 inpatients; foundation models outperform study baselines, particularly for delayed reactions.
limitations: EHR-coded outcomes and site-specific recording can affect transportability; predictive ranking does not establish prospective prescribing safety.

research_problem: Can domain adaptation improve MRI classification of invasive bladder cancer across centers?
ai_method: DADCNet combines source–target representation alignment with deep contrastive learning.
study_summary: Multicenter experiments report accuracy and F1 of 0.955 and AUC of 0.991 against convolutional and transformer comparators.
limitations: The adaptation setup uses target-domain samples; these results should not be assumed to represent deployment at a completely unseen hospital.

research_problem: Can emergency-call language reveal cardiac arrest within sixty seconds?
ai_method: DyLM-OHCA learns evolving dialogue patterns from call transcripts rather than relying only on isolated keywords.
study_summary: Training uses 158,973 transcripts from three South Korean regions; AUROC is 0.937, while AUPRC is 0.456, and conversational flow contributes to detection.
limitations: The lower precision–recall performance matters for rare events; transcript benchmarks do not establish a prospective improvement in resuscitation outcomes.

research_problem: Can routine echocardiography and EHR data estimate exercise capacity in heart failure?
ai_method: Multimodal multi-instance learning models multiple echo views and cross-modal interactions to predict peak oxygen consumption.
study_summary: External performance reaches R² 0.541 for peak VO₂ and AUROC 0.870 for identifying high-risk patients, exceeding the study comparator.
limitations: Predicted exercise capacity is a surrogate; it does not establish equivalence to measured CPET or benefit from altered treatment decisions.

research_problem: Which donor and recipient factors predict outcomes after haploidentical transplantation?
ai_method: Gradient boosting, partial-dependence analysis and surrogate trees characterize nonlinear prognostic relationships.
study_summary: In 668 single-center recipients, age and selected HLA mismatches stratify three-year survival; simulated donor choices shift modeled risk quartiles.
limitations: Donor-selection simulations do not show observed survival gains from an intervention; independent multicenter validation remains necessary.

research_problem: Which adaptation strategies best transfer ICU sepsis models between hospitals?
ai_method: A systematic deep-model benchmark compares direct generalization, fine-tuning or retraining, target training, domain adaptation and fusion.
study_summary: Across 216,536 ICU stays in HiRID, MIMIC-IV and eICU, strategy rankings vary with available target data; routine fine-tuning performs poorly.
limitations: Results concern harmonized retrospective datasets; an adaptation strategy is not universally best across hospitals or operational constraints.

research_problem: What explains success and failure in national digitalization and clinical-AI deployment programs?
ai_method: Longitudinal qualitative evaluations compare NHS infrastructure, digital-exemplar and AI Lab programs.
study_summary: Three programs are examined using 1,079 interviews, 819 observations and 2,219 documents; sociotechnical coordination and stable governance recur as major issues.
limitations: AI Lab is one of three substantive program cases; these aggregate implementation data do not measure an individual AI model’s clinical accuracy or treatment effect.

research_problem: Can LLM post-processing reduce accent-related errors in clinical speech recognition?
ai_method: Whisper and WhisperX transcripts are corrected through a chained GPT-4o stage.
study_summary: Non-native English speech initially has higher transcription error rates; the WhisperX–GPT pipeline reduces the disparity in evaluated clinical recordings.
limitations: Improved transcription on tested recordings does not establish fairness for all accents or exclude clinically important hallucinated corrections.

research_problem: Does an ambient AI scribe reduce documentation burden in routine general practice?
ai_method: A prospective multicenter before–after mixed-methods study combines timed observation with clinician and patient perspectives.
study_summary: Across 535 consultations involving twelve practitioners, documentation is 42.7 seconds shorter per consultation, without a change in total consultation duration.
limitations: The short nonrandomized comparison cannot isolate every causal effect; inaccurate summaries and interference with sensitive discussions remain reported concerns.

research_problem: Can OCT-based digital reconstruction approximate MRI whole-eye geometry in myopia?
ai_method: CET-1 uses nnU-Net tissue segmentation, contour extraction, optical calibration and three-dimensional surface reconstruction.
study_summary: Eighty eyes from forty individuals are compared with MRI; geometric agreement spans a broad axial-length range and reveals myopia-associated shape differences.
limitations: Segmentation training images and validation eyes are separate denominators; geometric agreement does not establish treatment benefit or future-state prediction.

research_problem: Can targeted Boolean rubrics make health-LLM evaluation more consistent and efficient?
ai_method: Adaptive Precise Boolean rubrics decompose open-ended response assessment into granular yes/no criteria for human and automated raters.
study_summary: Metabolic-health evaluations show higher agreement and roughly half the rating time compared with conventional Likert scales.
limitations: Rater agreement and speed are evaluation properties, not proof that a health-language model is clinically safe or improves disease outcomes.

research_problem: Can federated and sequential model training jointly improve fairness across unequal imaging sites?
ai_method: FedTM warms up through federated learning and then sequentially refines a travelling model.
study_summary: Parkinson classification uses 1,817 scans from 83 sites; reported AUROC rises from 77% to 82%, with lower error disparities and smaller-site training load.
limitations: Site-level benchmark improvements do not establish clinical equity outcomes, and distributed training alone does not prove complete privacy protection.

research_problem: Can AI shorten the CTA workflow for detecting and localizing spinal vascular fistulas?
ai_method: SDAVFdoc combines 3D segmentation, anatomical localization priors and DenseNet classification.
study_summary: The multicenter study includes 718 patients; reported detection AUC is 0.928–0.954 and image-processing time falls from about forty-one to one minute.
limitations: Technical workflow savings are not the same as shorter treatment delays or improved neurologic outcomes.

research_problem: Can transcriptomic learning prioritize mechanisms linking periodontitis and Alzheimer-like pathology?
ai_method: Random-forest selection, SVM refinement and interpretable network analysis connect single-cell and rat hippocampal profiles.
study_summary: The cGAS–STING pathway is prioritized; follow-up experiments find that Huanglian Jiedu decoction reduces inflammatory activation and improves cognition in preclinical models.
limitations: The therapeutic evidence is cellular and animal-based; it does not establish efficacy or safety in patients with Alzheimer’s disease.

research_problem: Can standardized specialty-triage benchmarking guide medical-LLM development?
ai_method: MedTriage organizes real clinician–patient dialogues; competition results inform a relevant/random-sample ensemble strategy for MedGPT-Guide.
study_summary: The enhanced system improves the study’s triage benchmark across general and specialty scenarios.
limitations: Competition accuracy is not evidence of safe autonomous patient routing; external generalization, security and deployment governance remain unresolved.

research_problem: Can cough-based respiratory classifiers remain useful across recording devices?
ai_method: Adversarial device-invariant audio features combine with demographics and symptoms under an invariant-risk loss.
study_summary: More than 10,000 cases cover seven conditions; reported overall comorbidity AUROC is 0.8907, with disease-specific variation.
limitations: Cross-device benchmarking does not establish unsupervised home-screening effectiveness or equivalent performance across all populations.

research_problem: Does pediatric development change how ECG AI predicts biological sex?
ai_method: A previously developed ECG classifier is externally evaluated across pediatric age groups, with saliency-based analysis.
study_summary: External AUROC increases from 0.64 before puberty to 0.94 after puberty, and the developmental pattern replicates at another children’s hospital.
limitations: The result is developmental discrimination of a recorded sex label; it does not validate diagnosis or imply that performance is age-invariant.

research_problem: Can organ-specific imaging clocks characterize aging and predict future disease?
ai_method: LASSO age models use nested cross-validation on imaging phenotypes; exploratory graphical modeling examines organ dependencies.
study_summary: The study models seven organs using 1,777 imaging phenotypes from 11,000 healthy participants and links age gaps to subsequent disease, mortality and protein signatures.
limitations: These are regularized linear learning models rather than deep neural networks; cross-sectional dependency graphs do not demonstrate causal organ-aging pathways.

research_problem: Can an opaque opioid risk-scoring benchmark be reproduced in independent administrative data?
ai_method: Reconstructed NarxCare-style scoring models are tested using prescription-monitoring and health-plan claims data with additional socioeconomic covariates.
study_summary: Across reconstructed models, precision of 0.01–0.32 and F1 of 0.02–0.39 fall below advertised benchmark values.
limitations: Independent reconstruction cannot establish exact equivalence to undisclosed proprietary implementation; the findings motivate transparency rather than reveal every internal model decision.

research_problem: Can histopathology distinguish primary ovarian mucinous carcinoma from gastrointestinal metastasis?
ai_method: MOCOPM selects the best of three neural networks after internal cross-validation and tests it at external hospitals.
study_summary: Among 167 patients, average AUROC is 0.91 internally and 0.96 externally.
limitations: The sample is limited and retrospective; diagnostic discrimination does not establish improved treatment selection or patient outcomes.

research_problem: How accurately can language-based models detect depression across published studies?
ai_method: Systematic review and meta-analysis synthesize NLP and machine-learning classifiers using spoken or written language.
study_summary: Of 123 included articles, different subsets support each metric; pooled accuracy is 0.80 across 43 studies and 40,983 text samples.
limitations: Heterogeneous sources, languages and classifiers limit pooled interpretation; text samples are not necessarily unique patients.

research_problem: Can diagnostic criteria be represented as an auditable computational symptom space?
ai_method: A deterministic, explicit-rule framework formalizes consensus diagnostic criteria instead of learning probabilistic patterns from text.
study_summary: Demonstrations analyze schizophrenia-spectrum distinctions and overlap between Long COVID definitions and depressive or anxiety criteria.
limitations: Logical overlap in formal criteria does not demonstrate that affected patients share the same underlying disease or replace clinical diagnosis.

research_problem: Can combined clinical text and tabular embeddings generalize across sepsis tasks?
ai_method: SepsisDRM jointly encodes structured variables and narrative records into reusable patient representations.
study_summary: Training includes 19,526 sepsis patients; the model identifies four phenotypes and reports outcome AUCs of 0.92, 0.94 and 0.78 across retrospective, prospective and external datasets.
limitations: The external drop in discrimination matters; representation transfer and prospective data evaluation do not establish improved sepsis treatment outcomes.

research_problem: Do general language models transfer reliably to Romanian oncology question answering?
ai_method: MedQARo compares zero-shot prompting, supervised fine-tuning and API-accessed language models on clinical extraction and reasoning tasks.
study_summary: The dataset contains 105,880 question–answer pairs derived from 1,242 patients at two centers; fine-tuned models outperform zero-shot approaches.
limitations: Many questions originate from the same patients, and benchmark answer quality does not establish safe independent clinical decision-making.

research_problem: Can a smaller oncology-specific language model support cancer phenotyping and diagnosis generation?
ai_method: CancerLLM adapts a seven-billion-parameter Mistral-style architecture through oncology training and task fine-tuning.
study_summary: Training includes 2.7 million clinical notes and 515,000 pathology reports; internal F1 is 91.78% for phenotype extraction and 86.81% for diagnosis generation.
limitations: Notes and reports can be repeated observations; internal extraction accuracy does not establish diagnostic safety across institutions.

research_problem: Can a coarse-to-fine network measure cervical alignment when C7 is obscured?
ai_method: Global keypoint detection and localized C2/C7 specialists refine radiographic landmarks through a multilayer-perceptron localization stage.
study_summary: Training uses 5,604 images; external tests enriched for obscured C7 show strong agreement and lower measurement error than a single-stage baseline.
limitations: Agreement with reference measurements is a technical endpoint; the enriched test distribution may differ from routine consecutive radiographs.

research_problem: Can a verified LLM workflow assist evidence synthesis for prolapse surgery?
ai_method: ChatGPT supports screening, extraction and statistical synthesis within a PRISMA workflow checked against conventional analyses.
study_summary: The review includes eighteen RCTs involving 1,668 women; screening recall is 69.8%, while verified full-text and extraction tasks show higher agreement.
limitations: Screening misses remain substantial, and wide surgical comparison intervals do not establish one superior operation; this publication is not a new patient RCT.

research_problem: How strong is the clinical evidence for computer vision in vascular surgery?
ai_method: Systematic review evaluates applications, study design, bias and TRIPOD+AI reporting.
study_summary: Among 288 studies, most use retrospective data; only fifteen percent have low risk of bias and reporting adherence is limited.
limitations: The number of reviewed studies does not equal new patients; methodological limitations constrain translation of reported technical performance.

research_problem: Can genotype-to-ECG learning expand cardiovascular phenotype analysis in biobanks?
ai_method: CapECG uses an attention-based capsule network to map genetic variation into 169 ECG traits.
study_summary: After testing in 7,422 people, predicted traits are generated for 388,284 genotype-only participants and improve cardiovascular risk prediction over a polygenic-score comparator.
limitations: Predicted traits are modeled quantities rather than recorded ECGs; downstream genetic associations require caution about shared model-derived structure.

research_problem: Can longitudinal EHR learning predict diabetic kidney disease progression across populations?
ai_method: Deep prognostic models combine clinical, biochemical and prescription histories, with SHAP interpretation.
study_summary: Development covers 569,680 people at 165 Hong Kong facilities; external AUCs in UK Biobank and CHARLS range from 0.746 to 0.820.
limitations: External discrimination is lower than development performance, and prognostic ranking does not establish benefit from model-directed intervention.

research_problem: Can clinical language improve recurrence prediction after atrial-fibrillation ablation?
ai_method: A dual-branch network combines 1D ResNet structured-data features with representations from four language models.
study_summary: Across 2,508 patients at five centers, MedGemma-derived text features perform best, with test AUC 0.911.
limitations: The cohorts are retrospective; language features and institution-specific documentation may affect performance outside the evaluated settings.

research_problem: What economic value might AI-guided coronary treatment selection generate under simulated adoption?
ai_method: A retrospective health-economic model simulates revascularization choices informed by predicted events, mortality and willingness-to-pay.
study_summary: Data from 25,942 adults suggest potentially large cost and QALY gains when modeled decisions are economically optimized.
limitations: The gains depend on simulation and adoption assumptions; they are not observed savings or patient benefits from a randomized AI deployment.

research_problem: Can shared radiology–pathology representations improve breast-cancer model transfer?
ai_method: Vision transformers, modality adapters, contrastive alignment and domain-generalization techniques combine mammography with histopathology.
study_summary: Benchmark evaluation across four named public resources reports mean AUC 0.90 with smaller leave-domain-out gaps than comparators.
limitations: Public datasets represent different imaging tasks and populations; benchmark domain transfer does not establish linked multimodal patient benefit in clinical deployment.

research_problem: Can AI standardize the analysis of clinical safety incidents?
ai_method: AI-ILS learns the HFACS incident taxonomy from expert-labeled reports.
study_summary: Training uses 1,548 incidents; testing on 350 reports shows 88% expert concordance and substantially faster review, with radiation-oncology deployment experience.
limitations: Faster retrospective classification does not demonstrate that future adverse events or patient harm are reduced.

research_problem: Do automated EHR triggers improve access to palliative care?
ai_method: A randomized-trial evidence synthesis evaluates automated identification and referral support rather than one newly trained model.
study_summary: Seven trials involving 125,666 patients show higher consultation and advance-planning documentation rates; several utilization and psychological outcomes do not improve significantly.
limitations: Algorithms across trials may differ, and increased referrals should not be interpreted as established mortality or quality-of-life benefit.

research_problem: How safe are public chatbot answers to patients’ medical-advice questions?
ai_method: Physician-led red teaming evaluates four chatbot systems using the HealthAdvice dataset and structured safety judgments.
study_summary: Evaluation covers 888 responses to 222 questions; problematic-response rates range from 21.6% to 43.2%, with unsafe advice in five to thirteen percent.
limitations: These are version- and question-set-specific ratings, not observed population rates of patient injury.

research_problem: Can anatomical priors make efficient breast-imaging adaptation more transferable?
ai_method: A-VPT inserts tissue-aware visual prompts into a frozen transformer and aligns modalities contrastively.
study_summary: INbreast, BUSI and Duke-Breast-MRI benchmarks show stronger classification and segmentation with fewer than two percent of full fine-tuning’s tunable parameters.
limitations: Parameter efficiency and interpretable attention do not establish causal anatomical reasoning or clinical outcome improvement.

research_problem: Can text-guided segmentation produce more clinically usable lung-lesion measurements?
ai_method: BiomedLoop couples Grounding DINO localization, SEEM refinement and uncertainty-aware features, feeding mask-derived pseudo-text back into training.
study_summary: Five public benchmarks show improved overlap and boundary metrics; structured outputs follow the TID 1500 reporting specification.
limitations: Automatically generated pseudo-text is not independent clinical-report evidence; benchmark gains do not establish live diagnostic utility.

research_problem: Can physiological constraints correct unstable contactless heart-rate estimates?
ai_method: An adaptive post-processing algorithm constrains estimated heart-rate changes using elevation and recovery dynamics.
study_summary: Across three public rPPG datasets, the fraction within ten beats per minute improves substantially with low computational overhead.
limitations: The correction is physiology-guided rather than a newly learned neural model; performance on existing estimators does not establish arrhythmia safety or universal robustness.

research_problem: Can remotely administered Parkinson assessments retain useful motor and cognitive discrimination?
ai_method: MaC-VC combines simplified videoconference testing with machine-learning classifiers and bidirectional cross-dataset validation.
study_summary: A 145-person remote cohort is compared with 1,264 expert-rated PPMI assessments; early-versus-advanced disease classification exceeds AUC 0.9 across datasets.
limitations: Cross-sectional disease-stage classification and agreement do not establish equivalence for every examination item or longitudinal treatment monitoring.

research_problem: Can geometric learning rapidly approximate ventricular activation for CRT planning?
ai_method: Graph networks and geometry-informed neural operators emulate finite-element activation maps and infer pacing-site parameters.
study_summary: GINO is stronger on synthetic shapes, while GNN and GINO have similar errors on real ventricular geometries; noisy-input recovery supports a planning prototype.
limitations: Simulated activation and parameter recovery are not evidence that model-selected lead placement improves CRT response in patients.

research_problem: When do LLMs or clinician–LLM teams outperform clinicians in open-ended diagnosis and triage?
ai_method: A multilevel random-effects meta-analysis synthesizes fifty studies covering twenty-five language models.
study_summary: Collaborative diagnostic performance tends to improve, while LLM-versus-clinician rankings vary with top-k definitions and triage performance is similar.
limitations: Nested observations, model variability and study flaws limit clinical conclusions; top-ten answers are not equivalent to a correct first diagnosis.

research_problem: Can scarce expert labels and noisy EHR labels jointly support rare-disease phenotyping?
ai_method: WEST iteratively refines probabilistic silver labels while training a weakly supervised transformer.
study_summary: Two pediatric pulmonary-disease case studies show improved phenotype classification, subphenotyping and progression prediction.
limitations: Performance in two conditions at one children’s hospital does not establish transfer to all rare diseases or health systems.

research_problem: How feasible and reliable are wearable EEG systems for detecting mild cognitive impairment?
ai_method: A systematic review examines devices, signal processing, extracted features and learning-based classification.
study_summary: Twenty-one studies cover sixteen devices, with accuracy ranging from 46% to 95%; ensemble learning and multimodal integration are among proposed design factors.
limitations: The wide range reflects heterogeneous evidence and does not establish a single device’s accuracy or community-screening effectiveness.

research_problem: Can glaucoma screening models be developed in a population underrepresented in existing AI datasets?
ai_method: Image selection precedes vision-transformer scoring and aggregation of fundus photographs.
study_summary: POAAGG provides 64,129 images from 1,782 cases and 682 controls; AUC is 0.925 internally and 0.920 on the Chinese-ancestry REFUGE-1 dataset.
limitations: Repeated images are not independent people, and external dataset accuracy does not establish population-screening benefit.

research_problem: Can a lower-back sensor identify probable REM sleep behavior disorder at home?
ai_method: Machine-learning classifiers use mobility features from repeated overnight inertial recordings.
study_summary: Seventy-three participants, including fifteen iRBD cases, complete laboratory assessment and six home nights; classification improves as more nights are recorded.
limitations: The small case count and moderate specificity support staged screening rather than replacement of diagnostic video-polysomnography.

research_problem: Can noncontrast CT estimate metabolic activity normally measured by PET in adipose tissue?
ai_method: A conditional GAN with fat-focused loss predicts regional PET standardized uptake values from paired CT data.
study_summary: Evaluation in two cohorts shows agreement and reproducibility of predicted adipose activation across regions.
limitations: A learned PET surrogate does not directly measure tracer uptake and requires independent validation before replacing PET-based clinical decisions.

research_problem: Can automated whole-thigh imaging reveal muscle-distribution biomarkers of functional decline?
ai_method: Transformer segmentation measures twenty-seven musculoskeletal structures and derives volume and distribution features.
study_summary: Among 37,004 UK Biobank participants, segmentation Dice is 0.896; posterior–anterior muscle ratio is associated with weakness, sarcopenia, mortality and falls.
limitations: These are observational biomarker associations; greater predictive information does not establish a causal mechanism or benefit from changing muscle distribution.

research_problem: Where can AI support diagnostic imaging of prostate cancer?
ai_method: A review surveys machine learning, deep learning and radiomics across ultrasound, multiparametric MRI and PSMA PET/CT.
study_summary: The synthesis covers detection, lesion characterization, risk stratification and treatment assessment, alongside integration and ethics challenges.
limitations: Review-level descriptions of high accuracy are not a single pooled estimate or proof of readiness across every scanner and clinical population.

research_problem: Can surgical pretraining capture temporal procedure context as well as spatial anatomy?
ai_method: SurgVISTA combines video reconstruction pretraining with surgery-expert image-level knowledge distillation.
study_summary: Pretraining uses 3,650 videos and 3.55 million frames; thirteen video datasets test four downstream tasks across six procedures.
limitations: Frames and videos are different units; stronger scene understanding does not establish safer autonomous intervention or patient benefit.

research_problem: Can consistent language and image representations connect chest radiographs with CT ILD burden?
ai_method: ARCTIC-ILD couples calibrated radiographic evidence extraction, terminology-conditioned CT masks and a vision-language consistency audit.
study_summary: Paired CXR–CT evaluation reports fewer textual hallucinations and stronger phrase-to-mask alignment without added inference delay.
limitations: An internal consistency audit does not guarantee clinical truth, and paired-cohort benchmarking is not a prospective triage trial.

research_problem: Can anatomical prompts and volumetric context adapt SAM to lung-lesion segmentation?
ai_method: StructSAM introduces structural priors, inter-slice aggregation and parameter-efficient adaptation.
study_summary: LIDC-IDRI tests lung segmentation, while KiTS19 and pancreatic data examine transfer to other structures.
limitations: Cross-organ benchmark transfer does not establish robustness to all clinical acquisition shifts or reliable cancer diagnosis.

research_problem: Can multimodal anomaly detection provide interpretable clinical-skills assessment?
ai_method: Video, audio and monitor signals train MEMTO against ideal-performance reference patterns, with SHAP-based interpretation.
study_summary: In ninety anesthesia residents, derived scores correlate 0.78 with expert ratings and achieve ICC 0.75.
limitations: Agreement in simulation does not establish equitable high-stakes competency decisions or prediction of future patient-care performance.

research_problem: Can joint learning improve tumor segmentation and classification with limited MRI labels?
ai_method: DARE-FUSE combines domain alignment, task-specific decoders, pixel uncertainty and a generated lesion-removal prior.
study_summary: BraTS and classification benchmarks show complementary task gains and more gradual performance loss as pixel annotations decrease.
limitations: Generated tumor-free counterparts are model constructs; interpretable priors do not establish reliable surgical or radiotherapy outcomes.

research_problem: Can state-space and frequency representations improve efficient medical-image segmentation?
ai_method: CFG-MambaNet combines variable-scale Mamba blocks, low/high-frequency features and adaptive context aggregation.
study_summary: Experiments cover cardiac MRI, endoscopy, dermoscopy and pathology through four public datasets.
limitations: Multi-modality benchmarks demonstrate technical transfer, not universal clinical generalization or a measured reduction in diagnostic harm.

research_problem: Can radiology and pathology provide surrogates for fibroblast-mediated immune exclusion?
ai_method: Calibrated slide attention, radiopathomic fusion and domain alignment learn transcriptomic ERS–CAF reference scores; an MRI student is distilled afterward.
study_summary: In 126 chordoma cases, imaging predictions track molecular profiles and prognosis, with zero-shot pan-cancer analyses.
limitations: Surrogate concordance and observational prognosis do not establish that the inferred pathway causes treatment response or predicts benefit prospectively.

research_problem: How are machine-learning approaches used to predict drug–drug interactions?
ai_method: A review examines feature-based models, deep networks and graph neural architectures alongside clinical pharmacovigilance applications.
study_summary: The synthesis connects computational discovery with drug-safety monitoring and highlights interpretability, generalization and workflow barriers.
limitations: Review-level promise does not provide a single validated accuracy estimate or ensure that all predicted interactions are clinically consequential.

research_problem: Can bile-acid learning models support acute pancreatitis diagnosis and severity warning?
ai_method: Metabolomic profiling, network analysis and machine-learning panel selection identify diagnostic and progression signatures.
study_summary: A 948-person multicenter validation cohort evaluates sixty-three bile acids, supporting distinct nine- and thirteen-marker panels.
limitations: The registered study is observational, not an interventional patient RCT; molecular discrimination does not establish outcome benefit from using the panels.

research_problem: Does clinician–LLM collaboration consistently improve clinical performance and efficiency?
ai_method: A systematic review meta-analyzes human-plus-AI workflows, with preprints reserved for sensitivity analyses.
study_summary: Ten peer-reviewed studies show context-dependent score gains, no overall time saving and persistent documentation-error concerns; some accuracy estimates are highly imprecise.
limitations: Collaboration does not uniformly beat AI alone, and wide prediction intervals prevent a general claim of clinical benefit.

research_problem: Can anatomy-guided Mamba models improve CT delineation of liver cancer lesions?
ai_method: Prompt-Mamba-AF combines liver-specific prompts, volumetric state-space modeling and topology-preserving boundary filtering.
study_summary: LiTS, 3DIRCADb and CHAOS benchmarks show stronger overlap and boundary results with a 27.6-million-parameter network.
limitations: Benchmark nodule sensitivity and compactness do not establish prospective multisite contouring safety or improved surgical outcomes.

research_problem: Which antiviral and virus-specific host responses can multi-omics learning distinguish?
ai_method: An explainable classifier integrates genetics, transcriptomics and proteomics, with SHAP and Mendelian-randomization analyses.
study_summary: The analysis contrasts shared interferon responses with coagulation, inflammatory and cellular-response differences across COVID-19, influenza and RSV.
limitations: Cross-dataset differences and causal-instrument assumptions constrain mechanistic claims; this is not a test of the proposed targeted treatments.

research_problem: Can predicted antibiotic outcomes incorporate clinicians’ treatment preferences?
ai_method: Clinical prediction models for thirteen antibiotics are weighted using preference rankings from forty-nine prescribers.
study_summary: Models trained on 93,906 patients favor more correctly targeted Access-category and oral antibiotics in an emergency-department simulation.
limitations: Simulated choices do not demonstrate observed reductions in resistance, adverse events or treatment failure during prospective prescribing.

research_problem: Can CT radiomics and clinical data identify occult gastric-cancer peritoneal metastases?
ai_method: A multimodal prediction model is evaluated across development, external, incremental and prospective trial-source cohorts, with a crossover reader comparison.
study_summary: AUCs range from 0.834 to 0.857; radiologist assistance increases average AUC from 0.735 to 0.872.
limitations: A prospective source cohort and a reader crossover are distinct from randomizing patients to AI-guided staging; performance does not establish avoided laparoscopy harms.

research_problem: Can whole-slide learning detect malignant effusions and infer tumor origin?
ai_method: MAMILE-UNI uses a data-efficient deep framework across cytology smears, cell blocks and histopathology.
study_summary: Evaluation includes 1,250 cytology and 1,196 histopathology slides, supporting malignancy and tissue-of-origin discrimination.
limitations: Slide counts are not necessarily independent patients; statistical association and multiple accuracy metrics do not establish clinical outcome benefit.

research_problem: Can panoramic radiographs and clinical metadata triage temporomandibular abnormalities for MRI?
ai_method: Anatomically constrained attention and ensemble multimodal learning combine paired open- and closed-mouth images.
study_summary: Among 1,355 patients representing 2,710 joints, the best ensemble reaches AUC 0.86 against MRI-detectable pathology.
limitations: The two joints from a patient are correlated; screening discrimination does not establish that MRI can safely be omitted.

research_problem: Can a hybrid local–global architecture improve efficient volumetric tumor segmentation?
ai_method: HMC-Transducer combines direction-aware 3D Mamba blocks with gated CNN feature fusion.
study_summary: LiTS17, MSD-liver and KiTS21 benchmarks show improved segmentation and computational efficiency over selected CNN and transformer comparators.
limitations: Technical benchmark generalization does not establish prospective contouring reliability or better cancer-treatment outcomes.

research_problem: How are deep-learning tools implemented prospectively in real clinical workflows?
ai_method: An implementation-science systematic review maps strategies and clinical and organizational outcomes.
study_summary: Twenty articles are included, mostly ophthalmology; only one evaluates implementation cost and none assesses sustainability.
limitations: This publication synthesizes prospective implementation studies; it is not itself a new prospective AI validation or patient RCT.

research_problem: Does a cardiac imaging foundation model estimate ejection fraction equally well by recorded sex?
ai_method: A pretrained CMR–report model is fine-tuned in UK Biobank and audited using masking, resampling and sex-informed adaptation.
study_summary: Reduced-ejection-fraction identification performs worse in females, and simple masking or resampling does not remove the disparity.
limitations: The bias audit does not establish that any one mitigation transfers across all populations or that protected-attribute removal guarantees fairness.

research_problem: Can modality-specific uncertainty improve speech-based psychosis assessment?
ai_method: A multimodal model adaptively weights acoustic and linguistic information from structured and narrative speech.
study_summary: In 114 German-speaking participants, including thirty-two with early psychosis, reported F1 is 83% and expected calibration error is 0.045.
limitations: Language, task and sample composition constrain transfer; symptom prediction is not a substitute for a validated independent psychiatric diagnosis.

research_problem: Can coordinated language and imaging agents help recognize axial spondyloarthritis earlier?
ai_method: SpAgents uses planning, data, tool and doctor agents with long-term memory and imaging-model support.
study_summary: A 596-person dataset includes a fifty-one-patient multicenter test cohort; assistance improves junior clinicians’ and primary-care physicians’ diagnostic performance.
limitations: Reader assistance and a small external test set do not establish a reduction in real-world diagnostic delay or improved patient outcomes.

research_problem: Can language-based code embeddings improve EHR prediction across countries and coding systems?
ai_method: GRASP combines shared semantic code embeddings with a transformer prediction model.
study_summary: Training in UK Biobank and evaluation in FinnGen and Mount Sinai cover over one million people, with better disease and mortality discrimination than language-unaware comparators.
limitations: Relative gains in C-index improvement are not absolute C-index gains; cross-system prediction does not establish clinical intervention benefit.

research_problem: How ready is AI-based glaucoma progression prediction for clinical use?
ai_method: A systematic review evaluates quantitative performance, bias, study design and reporting across progression tasks.
study_summary: Forty-six reports represent forty-three distinct studies, with moderate-to-good reported performance but substantial heterogeneity and transparency gaps.
limitations: Reports and unique studies are different denominators; existing evidence does not establish one transferable progression model.

research_problem: Can natural facial dynamics quantify atypical expression patterns in autism?
ai_method: Video-derived emotion variation, facial intensity and muscle coordination are fused for classification and symptom regression.
study_summary: The study analyzes 184 sessions from ninety-nine autistic children and eighty-five peers, reporting classification accuracy 92.4% and AUC 0.977.
limitations: Group discrimination in the evaluated sample does not establish population-screening specificity or replace developmental clinical assessment.

research_problem: Can retinal OCT angiography be reconstructed without learned segmentation or manual labels?
ai_method: RADAR uses physics-aware vessel enhancement and topology-preserving centerline extraction.
study_summary: Healthy and diabetic-retinopathy data demonstrate three-dimensional vascular reconstruction and layer-specific morphological differences.
limitations: This is a classical computational pipeline rather than a newly trained AI model; its scope in an AI-only catalogue requires separate eligibility adjudication.

research_problem: Can training-only foundation guidance improve efficient cross-domain polyp segmentation?
ai_method: Prysm-Net combines a ViT backbone, boundary-salience module, SAM distillation and auxiliary multimodal cross-attention.
study_summary: In-domain and cross-domain benchmarks show stronger segmentation while auxiliary guidance is removed at inference.
limitations: Benchmark robustness and efficient inference do not establish a reduction in missed polyps during live colonoscopy.

research_problem: Can medical language models distinguish reliable from contradictory context?
ai_method: HealthContradict provides expert-verified questions, evidence-grounded answers and paired documents with conflicting positions under varied prompts.
study_summary: Nine hundred twenty instances reveal differences in models’ ability to exploit correct context and resist misleading context.
limitations: Controlled document conflicts are not a full measure of safe clinical reasoning across uncertain or changing evidence.

research_problem: Do larger EHR foundation models generalize better than clinically guided models?
ai_method: A comparative study tests feed-forward, Mamba and transformer representations for future cervical myelopathy diagnosis.
study_summary: Around two million claims and institutional records support evaluation; large models are stronger internally, while clinically guided models transfer better externally.
limitations: Internal scale does not guarantee cross-system robustness, and early risk prediction does not establish improved diagnostic or treatment outcomes.

research_problem: Can coordinated LLM agents support evidence-aware cancer pain recommendations?
ai_method: OncoPainBot combines extraction, mechanism reasoning, treatment planning and safety checking, comparing seven LLMs and three retrieval strategies.
study_summary: Testing on 516 clinical records finds the strongest configuration with Claude-4 and RAG, with analgesic recommendation accuracy 0.841.
limitations: Agreement with recorded care is not proof of optimal prescribing or prospective opioid safety; patient-specific monitoring remains a source of error.

research_problem: Can one multimodal system support urological cancer diagnosis, subtyping and prognosis despite missing inputs?
ai_method: UroFusion-X combines imaging encoders, slide multiple-instance learning, omics graphs and tabular transformers through gated fusion and survival heads.
study_summary: Multicenter external and leave-center-out evaluations exceed baseline models and retain much predictive performance under modality dropout.
limitations: Decision-curve estimates and simulated missingness do not demonstrate actual reductions in unnecessary testing or improved clinical decisions.

research_problem: Can self-supervised pretraining reduce the labels needed for glioma segmentation?
ai_method: MAGPIE combines masked autoencoding, contrastive learning and sparse mixture-of-experts routing across MRI modalities.
study_summary: Pretraining uses 43,505 unlabeled scans; fine-tuning on twenty labeled cases yields 60.87% Dice on BraTS21 and a reported 70.32% out-of-distribution score.
limitations: Scans and labeled cases are different units; gains with scarce annotations do not establish deployment safety across every protocol or tumor subtype.
